A Day in the Life: On a cross-functional team, your day is about deciding what the team builds next and in what order. You carry out the ownership work: defining feature vision and scope, planning sprints, setting priorities, maintaining the product backlog and roadmap, and keeping an eye on competitors. You are accountable for a wide slice of delivery, from problem definition and user stories through QA, acceptance testing, and the sprint demo, making sure what ships is what the team agreed to and what users need. You are consulted across research, design, and engineering, since your priorities shape everyone's work. A typical day mixes backlog and planning work in Notion, Trello, and FigJam with constant conversation: a standup, backlog refinement, a sprint planning or demo session, and quick calls to unblock the team. You steer in short loops, reorder the backlog as you learn, and keep the team pointed at the highest-value work.
